Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: User-owned interactive text RPG campaign slot with 4-question world setup, HUD state, active NPC emotion, inventory, NPC relationships, and butterfly-effect timeline.

title.description: Display title of the RPG chronicle.

universe.description: Question 1: Chosen universe (anime, book, series, game, or original world).

characterSummary.description: Question 2: Player character role (canon, OC, or isekai), name, skills, and starting traits.

startingPoint.description: Question 3: Story moment and starting location.

toneAndDifficulty.description: Question 4: Atmosphere tone and harshness of consequences.

hudStatusAndInventory.description: Compact HUD condition and key items summary.

hudRelationsAndCanon.description: Compact HUD relations and canon impact summary.

canonDeviationPercent.description: Estimated butterfly-effect deviation from original canon (0 to 100).

activeNpc.description: Snapshot of the currently interacting NPC and their visible emotional state.

inventory.description: Bounded list of character inventory items.

npcs.description: Bounded list of encountered NPC relationship snapshots.

butterflyEvents.description: Bounded list of canon-altering butterfly effect milestones.

storySummary.description: Rolling summary of the campaign plot so far.

CampaignTurn.title: CampaignTurn
CampaignTurn.description: Immutable narrative turn in an RPG campaign including player action, GM prose, HUD snapshot, active NPC emotion, and branching choices.

playerAction.description: Action chosen or typed by the player before this turn.

narrative.description: 2-4 paragraphs of anti-godmodding GM narrative prose.

hudLine.description: Formatted HUD line for this turn.

activeNpc.description: Interacting NPC emotion snapshot during this turn.

choices.description: 3-4 distinct branching choices offered at the end of this turn.

/users/{userId}/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Per-user RPG campaign slots and live game state.

/users/{userId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/t.description: Ordered narrative turn history for a specific RPG campaign.
